start.description:
Indicates starting element for the slice.
For example, if T is an int, then this could indicate the starting numerical index.
If unspecified, then it is left up to the function consuming slice to determine the semantic. Often times
this is the first element.

stop.description:
Indicates ending element for the slice.
For example, if T is an int, then this could indicate the ending numerical index.
If unspecified, then it is left up to the function consuming slice to determine the semantic. Often times
this is the last element.

step.description:
Indicates stride for the slice.
If unspecified, then it is left up to the function consuming slice to determine the semantic. Often times
this is 1.
